# Asteroid Escape

- Control a ship on an HTML canvas using arrow keys.
- Asteroids fall from the top at increasing speed.
- Collect floating energy orbs for points.
- **Lose condition:** the ship collides with any asteroid.
- Goal: survive as long as possible and achieve a high score.

1: // Simple canvas game based on IDEA.md
2: // Assumes an HTML canvas element with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas element with id "game" not found.');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   // Set canvas size (fallback if not set in HTML)
12:   // Sound setup
13:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
14:   function playSound(freq, duration) {
15:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
16:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
17:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
18:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
19:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
20:     oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
21:     oscillator.start();
22:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
23:   }
24:   canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
25:   canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
26: 
27:   // Game state
28:   const player = { x: 50, y: canvas.height / 2, radius: 15, speed: 4 };
29:   const obstacles = [];
30:   const particles = []; // particle trail effects
31:   const obstacleFreq = 1500; // ms
32:   const obstacleSpeed = 3;
33:   let lastObstacle = 0;
34:   let score = 0;
35:   let gameOver = false;
36: 
37:   // Input handling
38:   const keys = {};
39:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => (keys[e.key] = true));
40:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => (keys[e.key] = false));
41: 
42:   function spawnObstacle() {
43:     // Random pastel color for each obstacle
44:     const hue = Math.random() * 360;
45:     const color = `hsl(${hue}, 70%, 50%)`;
46:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
47:     const y = Math.random() * (canvas.height - size);
48:     obstacles.push({ x: canvas.width, y, size, color });
49:   }
50: 
51:   // Helper to draw rounded rectangle
52:   function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
53:     ctx.beginPath();
54:     ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
55:     ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
56:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
57:     ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
58:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
59:     ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
60:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
61:     ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
62:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
63:     ctx.closePath();
64:     ctx.fill();
65:   }
66: 
67: 
68:   function update(dt) {
69:     // Player movement (WASD or arrow keys)
70:     if (keys.w || keys.ArrowUp) player.y -= player.speed;
71:     if (keys.s || keys.ArrowDown) player.y += player.speed;
72:     if (keys.a || keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= player.speed;
73:     if (keys.d || keys.ArrowRight) player.x += player.speed;
74:     // Keep inside bounds
75:     player.x = Math.max(player.radius, Math.min(canvas.width - player.radius, player.x));
76:     player.y = Math.max(player.radius, Math.min(canvas.height - player.radius, player.y));
77: 
78:     // Obstacles movement
79:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
80:       const o = obstacles[i];
81:       o.x -= obstacleSpeed;
82:       // Collision detection (circle vs square)
83:       const distX = Math.abs(player.x - (o.x + o.size / 2));
84:       const distY = Math.abs(player.y - (o.y + o.size / 2));
85:       if (distX > o.size / 2 + player.radius || distY > o.size / 2 + player.radius) {
86:         // no collision
87:       } else if (distX <= o.size / 2 || distY <= o.size / 2) {
88:         gameOver = true;
89:       } else {
90:         const dx = distX - o.size / 2;
91:         const dy = distY - o.size / 2;
92:         if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= player.radius * player.radius) {
93:           gameOver = true;
94:         }
95:       }
96:         if (o.x + o.size < 0) {
97:           obstacles.splice(i, 1);
98:           score++;
99:           // Play score sound
100:           playSound(440, 0.1);
101:         }
102:       }
103:     }
104: 
105:     // Add particle at player position
106:     particles.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y, radius: 2, alpha: 1 });
107: 
108:     // Update particles (fade out)
109:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
110:       const p = particles[i];
111:       p.alpha -= 0.02;
112:       if (p.alpha <= 0) {
113:         particles.splice(i, 1);
114:       }
115:     }
116: 
117:     // Spawn new obstacles
118:     if (Date.now() - lastObstacle > obstacleFreq) {
119:       spawnObstacle();
120:       // Play spawn sound
121:       playSound(220, 0.05);
122:       lastObstacle = Date.now();
123:     }
124:     }
125: 
126:     // Spawn new obstacles
127:     if (Date.now() - lastObstacle > obstacleFreq) {
128:       spawnObstacle();
129:       lastObstacle = Date.now();
130:     }
131:   }
132: 
133:   function draw() {
134:     // Background gradient
135:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
136:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1e3a8a'); // dark blue
137:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3b82f6'); // light blue
138:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
139:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
140:     
141:     // Draw particles (trail)
142:     particles.forEach(p => {
143:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${p.alpha})`;
144:       ctx.beginPath();
145:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
146:       ctx.fill();
147:     });
148:     
149:     // Draw player with radial gradient
150:     const playerGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(player.x, player.y, player.radius * 0.2, player.x, player.y, player.radius);
151:     playerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#a3e635');
152:     playerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#166534');
153:     ctx.fillStyle = playerGrad;
154:     ctx.beginPath();
155:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
156:     ctx.fill();
157:     
158:     // Draw obstacles with rounded rectangles
159:     obstacles.forEach((o) => {
160:       ctx.fillStyle = o.color || '#D32F2F';
161:       roundRect(o.x, o.y, o.size, o.size, 6);
162:     });
163:     
164:     // Draw score
165:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
166:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
167:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 30);
168:     if (gameOver) {
169:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
170:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
171:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
172:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
173:       ctx.font = '40px sans-serif';
174:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
175:     }
176:   }
177:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
178:     // Draw player
179:     ctx.fillStyle = '#4CAF50';
180:     ctx.beginPath();
181:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
182:     ctx.fill();
183:     // Draw obstacles
184:     ctx.fillStyle = '#D32F2F';
185:     obstacles.forEach((o) => {
186:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.size, o.size);
187:     });
188:     // Draw score
189:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
190:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
191:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 30);
192:     if (gameOver) {
193:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
194:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
195:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
196:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
197:       ctx.font = '40px sans-serif';
198:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
199:     }
200:   }
201: 
202:   let lastTime = 0;
203:   function loop(timestamp) {
204:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
205:     lastTime = timestamp;
206:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
207:     draw();
208:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
209:   }
210:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
211: })();

(End of file - total 211 lines)
</content>
